notes.title: Update V0.3.1
notes.notes:
v0.3.1

• New Game mode - Target mode. 
   Includes 20 sub-puzzles, where the goal of each puzzle is to clear all the special blocks.
• Optimized the jittering issue on the rhythm indicator caused by rotating the ghost piece.
• Optimized the editor
   Preferences will be automatically saved when entering level testing, the UI interface will automatically turn off the music and block keyboard operations.
• Adjusted the score system and score display.
• UI adjustments.
